solution:
from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix, precision_score, recall_score, roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier

data = load_breast_cancer()
print(data.target_names)          # index 0 = malignant, 1 = benign
X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True, as_frame=True)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)

model = DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=2, random_state=42).fit(X_train, y_train)
pred = model.predict(X_test)

cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, pred)

recall_malignant = recall_score(y_test, pred, pos_label=0)
precision_malignant = precision_score(y_test, pred, pos_label=0)

auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1])
print(cm, recall_malignant, precision_malignant, auc)

checks.test: cm is not None and [list(map(int, r)) for r in cm] == [[50, 3], [10, 80]]
auc is not None and 0.9 < float(auc) < 0.97
